method: For each original submission, verify artifact SHA-256 and official native argument identity against its leaf request digest. Join actual Run, Job, evaluation, science and role owners. Derive both interpolants with exact rational divided differences and segment slopes from the initial high observations. Read the model’s original reasons and separate authored scientific judgments from GX-derived facts and references.

b1_reference.adverse_boundary: Two R0 planner submissions were terminally rejected. The third executed the correct new Job and R1 reviewer verified the result. No closing planner fit within five turns. This B1 outcome remains adverse.

comparison_limits: The original B1 and final acquisition use identical case, frozen grader, numerical inputs, scientific objective, provider profile and per-Run ceilings. The final acquisition completes the missing closing planner within four turns. One stochastic Run on each revision does not separate planner schema, preload, terminal behavior and model sampling or establish a general quality or efficiency effect. The older simple performance grids contain no comparable source-bearing two-round experiment.

frozen_before_dispatch.observation: The public spec reproduces the prescribed hypotheses, grids, interpolation families, acquisition rule and budget. The same case and grader hashes appear in final and B1 freezes before either initial Job. Both supplement texts match the frozen case. Both arrived after the two initial Jobs were admitted and before their results and the first review. Source judgments thus test appraisal of new material alongside first-round measurements.

relative_hypotheses.observation: The reviewer derives 0/3 for low, whose maximum −1 is 0.75 below the −0.25 cutoff, and 3/3 for high, including both endpoints at equality. The model explains why these outcomes support H_high and refute H_low on the tested coordinates. The durable settlements preserve the valid negative low route and positive high route alongside their hypotheses and evaluations.

source_use.observation: The reviewer and first planner retain the high and low findings while accepting catalog revision 7 exclusively for prospective acquisition. Both reject the unsigned export as a basis for revising the measured −1 at x=1, preserve its asserted zero and missing calibration, and ground those judgments in the original low observation and evaluation. The closing decision explicitly recognizes that if the archive shared the same scale, both intervals would qualify, contradicting both exclusive hypotheses. The review model supplies the two source IDs, dispositions, compared paths and reasons. GX resolves their declared paths to the immutable artifact and route references. The planner directly submits each source artifact and permitted original evidence references.

alternative_methods.observation: The original reviewer and planner both give all eight catalog predictions. Independent exact interpolation of the three measured high points reproduces them, including the linear maximum of −5/64 at 29/16 and the quadratic maximum of −1/64 at 17/8. Each maximum is unique over the four permitted choices. The planner distinguishes these predicted scores from the later experiment.

next_experiment.observation: The first planner submitted distinct tagged candidates, quadratic at 2.125 and linear at 1.8125, in the complete fixture-grid input. Its durable decision at 15:54:29.030 UTC precedes new Job admission at 15:54:29.333 UTC and completion at 15:54:29.661 UTC. The next proposal links that decision to the new Job. Its immutable observations match the two chosen candidate IDs and coordinates. Neither coordinate occurred in the original six.

held_out.observation: The new Job measured −1/64 for the quadratic selection and −9/256 for the piecewise-linear selection. The signed difference is +5/256, or 0.01953125. The reviewer and closing planner report both scores and the same one-pair ordering. The linear choice scored 11/256 above its own predicted value, consistent with the reviewer’s 0.04296875. Both choices pass the cutoff. The R1 review and planner agree that the remaining catalog coordinates and continuous optimum are unmeasured.

independent_review.observation: Each round has an accepted evidence reviewer with a native thread different from the proposal author, and a distinct planner referring to that reviewer’s accepted assessment and frozen proposal. All four accepted products map to four separate leases, native turns and threads. Their official qualified gx.gx_submit_product arguments hash to their own GX call receipts. The planner is deliberately informed by the review. Worker-role independence here is assignment and authorship independence within one model family.

interpretive_review.observation: The original final reason reports the opposing source, conditional hypotheses, all candidate predictions, measured pair, score difference, two unmeasured catalog points and unknown continuous optimum. There is no inference of general superiority. All requested stages can be assessed for this final run. The public synthetic score law, prescribed objective, supplied hypotheses and named interpolation families restrict the inference to evidence handling and the observed finite experiment.
